name: Baseball
overview: Scripture encourages believers to keep the Lord at the center of all their endeavors, ensuring stability and integrity in their lives, as seen in Psalms 16:8 and Proverbs 20:7. The joy found in the fields and trees in Psalms 96:12 reminds us to appreciate God's creation, which can be reflected in wholesome activities like baseball. Committing our works to the Lord, as Proverbs 16:3 advises, brings establishment to our plans, while Ecclesiastes 2:24 highlights the goodness of enjoying the fruits of our labor as a blessing from God. Training children in the way they should go (Proverbs 22:6) underscores the importance of guiding the next generation in godly principles, which can be fostered through discipline and character-building found in sportsmanship.
